scope: isolated SSH transport with existing restricted key, no remote forwards; no production network/unit changes

fault.type: bidirectional traffic discarded without TCP FIN or RST

limitations: One isolated SSH connection with existing host-key pin and restricted key; no remote forwarding ports were opened.
Does not simulate changing the whole laptop WiFi, obtaining a new lease, captive portals, DNS outage, suspend or reboot.
Authentication recovery is separate from production forwarding readiness; the earlier live new-HTTPS tunnel kill probe covers that other fault.
Legacy tunnel settings remain unchanged: interval 20, count 3, restart delay 15 seconds.
